title: Composition of Bernoulli sets
description: Final version (October 2026), with errata; superseded by the monograph Bernoulli Types: Two-Sided Error in Approximate Membership, Retrieval, and Computation, Chapter 6. Error rates for complement, union, intersection, and difference of Bernoulli sets, computed per region of the true sets; marginal rate pairs do not compose exactly through nested expressions. Credits independent-event evaluation in probabilistic databases and Bloom-filter set operations.
